lines: Mallika R Iyer, Promoter Group, holds 1,234,500 shares before the offer and is not selling in it; the holding is valued at up to ₹166.90 crore (estimate, valued at offer price), shares not cash.
The shares are locked in for six months from the date of Allotment, so there is no liquidity event for them now.
Confidence is medium: the seller table does not include this holder, while promoter holding and shareholding pattern agree on the holding.
The gain and proceeds are not applicable as they are not in the seller table.
